verdict.rationale: Warp's docs and launch blog say its client source code is published at github.com/warpdotdev/warp under AGPL v3, an open license, and invite users to read and audit it. The GitHub repo itself shows an active open-source contribution process, and a community commenter discussing the open-source release confirms the code is available. Missing for 10: no evidence that the cloud/agent backend source is open (only the client is), and the community reports the release shipped without commit history.
